source: Business Offer (BO) Quality Scoring Model — text supplied by operator

criteria.P1: Agreement mentioned in title AND description
criteria.P2: Title 40–256 characters and not ALL CAPS
criteria.P3: Summary 250–500 characters; not copied from title or description opening
criteria.P4: Origin-country name/demonym in summary AND description
criteria.P6: Advantages at least 200 characters AND containing digits
criteria.P8: All selected structured agreements mentioned in summary, description AND partner role

local_interpretations.P1: Each field needs any one permitted agreement; need not be the same agreement. Semantic consistency remains a separate audit.
local_interpretations.P3: Casefold and collapse whitespace. Copy if summary equals title or normalised description starts with entire normalised summary.
local_interpretations.P4: Use bundled, non-official country dictionary or explicitly supplied country_terms; unknown origin/terms leave criterion unresolved.
local_interpretations.P8: All selected structured agreement names must be recognised; their agreement keyword/phrase must occur in all three text fields. This is not a semantic check.
local_interpretations.N1: Case-insensitive Unicode word boundaries across title, summary, description, advantages and partner_role. Quotes and US can cause false positives.
local_interpretations.N2: Count distinct entries in the illustrative source list, not repeated occurrences. The source list is not complete. Aliases cover spacing/hyphens only.
local_interpretations.N3: Python str.isupper; at least one cased letter, numbers/punctuation ignored.
local_interpretations.N4: Case-sensitive comparison of first 40 Unicode characters of both raw fields; both must contain at least 40 characters.
local_interpretations.lengths: Unicode code points in original field strings; no HTML or whitespace normalisation for lengths.
local_interpretations.missing: Absent/None/not_visible is unknown; present empty string/list is observed empty. Unknowns produce conservative score bounds.
local_interpretations.equivalence: Local documented interpretation; source SQL, full marketing lexicon and country table were not supplied. No claim of exact reproduction of EISMEA internal results.
